data.rationale: Corpus v14 has no clause for cash-pickup agent networks; condition CND-3 covers the case, a clause would cover the next one.
data.scope_suggestion: Where a payout partner distributes funds through cash-pickup agents, the bank shall obtain the partner's agent KYC standard and review a sample of agent KYC files at least quarterly.
data.suggested_standard: Internal Third-Party AML Standard 7.1 · Payout Agents

conditions: Corridor-scope vendor DD review completed and filed
Enhanced monitoring rules on payout agents live
Quarterly sample review of agent KYC files
